copper mountain.note: Good morning Copper Mountain! Hopefully everyone survived their Thanksgiving food comas and managed to squeeze into their ski pants this morning! Today we're expecting mostly sunny skis with a high of around 32F. Winds will be coming out of the west northwest at about 15-20 mph, with gusts reaching into the 40s Expect to see the weather start to change around 3:00pm. Clouds should be rolling in, temps will start dropping and hopefully we'll see the beginnings of our next storm. As always stay safe, always ride within your ability and give your fellow skiers and riders plenty of room. Enjoy the sun and hope this next storm delivers.

eldora.note: 10:14 AM update - Alpenglow lift is running at slower speeds due to wind. -- 5:30 AM update – Good morning, skiers and riders! Welcome to the Eldora snow report for Friday, November 27, 2026. Hope you're rested after all that turkey. Windmill and Klondike give you two top-to-bottom runs, plus the Woodward terrain park. It's 34 degrees with mostly sunny skies forecasted and a high near 38. It should be windy up top, so layer up and grab a neck gaiter. Skip the I-70 crowds this Black Friday and spend it at your local hill. See ya out there! And don't forget, season pass prices go up Tuesday! Save on Eldora Season Passes and lesson products through Monday, Nov 30. Give yourself more days on snow. Give someone you love a winter they won't forget. NWS Weather Snapshot: Mostly sunny, with a high near 38. Windy, with a west wind 30 to 36 mph. Safety: No trees or glades will be open. Expect thin, early-season conditions on Opening Day and beyond. Be prepared to ski and ride safely and responsibly on Opening Day and all season long, bearing in mind Your Responsibility Code every time you hit the slopes. Uphill/Nordic/Snowshoe Access is currently CLOSED. For the cross-country skiers, snowshoers, and uphill skiers out there, Eldora’s Nordic trail network and uphill access routes are NOT YET OPEN. Stay tuned here for updates. Parking: We will begin charging fees for single-occupancy vehicle (SOV) arrivals sometime in December. Stay tuned here for updates on when fees will begin. Learn more about parking at Eldora here . Stay informed: Before heading to the mountain this winter, always check this page, eldora.com/conditions , for the latest information and operational updates. You can also sign up for text alerts so you never miss a beat. Text one of the following keywords to (866) 965-6224 for alerts (message and data rates may apply). ELDORA for general alerts UPHILL for uphill-specific updates NORDIC for Nordic updates. Thanks for checking the Eldora snow report. We'll see you on the hill! -- GENERAL INFORMATION Lift Hours: 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM on weekdays, 8:30 AM to 4:00 PM on weekends. Lifts currently open: Alpenglow only. Lodge Hours: 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM on weekdays, 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM on weekends. Lodges currently open: Timbers, West Wing, Lower Indian Peaks Lodge. Pass & Ticket Services, Rental, and Retail: Please visit Lower Indian Peaks Lodge. Single-Occupancy Vehicle (SOV) Fees: Vehicles with two or more occupants may park for free seven days a week . Vehicles carrying only a driver will be charged $10 on weekends, during certain holiday periods, and on weekdays with 10 or more inches of new snow. Credit/debit is accepted; cash is not. High-Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) Parking: Per Boulder County requirements, the Elk Lot (nearest to Alpenglow chair) is reserved seven days a week for vehicles with three or more occupants on a first-come, first-served basis. Learn more here . EV Parking: Eldora provides 30 free ChargePoint EV charging stations. These premium parking spots are available on a first-come, first-served basis and are subject to the SOV policy above. To park in the EV lot, you MUST have an EV and be actively charging. If you are finished charging, please move your car to another non-EV space so others can use the chargers. Easy, Convenient RTD Bus Service from Boulder: RTD’s NB route brings you from Downtown Boulder Station straight to the Alpenglow chairlift in about 40 minutes; riders 19 and under ride RTD for FREE through RTD's Zero Fare for Youth program. For schedule and fare info, visit rtd-denver.com .

snowbird.note: Resort Update: The Aerial Tram, Little Cloud, Gadzoom, Wilbere and Chickadee are scheduled to start spinning at 9 a.m., conditions permitting. All uphill travel is closed and early-season conditions exist. Please be aware of objects at or below the snow surface. Mountain Report: Happy Friday, folks! It's gonna be another great day at The Bird with early-season top-to-bottom skiing and the groomers riding in mid-season form. After a brief dryspell this week, the weather is starting to turn! Expect a windy day out there today ahead of a small storm overnight; we're talking 1-4 inches. Tonight is just the appetizer ahead of the main event early/mid next week when the forecasts are calling for a significant snow event. So enjoy the groomers today, the soft stuff tomorrow, and get those powder skis tuned up for next week! And for all you aspiring rockstars out there, we have Karaoke in the Tram Club from 3-6p today! You can shred on the mountain, but can you rip on the mic? Swing by to enjoy a drink or two, some tasty food, and performances from Little Cottonwood's greatest unknown stars. Tram Club Karaoke - 21+ It’s early season, so take it easy out there. Ski and ride in control, respect closures and rope lines, and remember that lift and terrain availability can change throughout the day. Give me The Bird.
